effects.name: Star Volley
effects.notes: Three jagged stars bob in formation, shedding star motes.

effects.name: Impact Burst
effects.notes: White jagged burst, streak sparks bouncing on the floor, dust puffs, light pulse.

effects.name: Shock Ring
effects.notes: Two broken, uneven shock rings on the floor kicking up dust (a ring by design).

effects.name: Fire Ball
effects.notes: Flickering hot head; flame blobs shed backwards cool white > yellow > red > smoke; embers.

effects.name: Fire Burst
effects.notes: Flash, jagged burst, flame blobs boil up and turn to drifting smoke, embers fall.

effects.name: Flame Pillar
effects.notes: Floor flicker, then a column of rising flame blobs and tongues, sparks at the base, smoke off the top.

effects.name: Flame Aura
effects.notes: Flames and embers rise along the body edges.

effects.name: Water Jet
effects.notes: Gather, then a jittering jet with ragged edges, spray leaving the stream, splash at the end.

effects.name: Bubble Shot
effects.notes: Glossy head with droplets and mist shed behind.

effects.name: Water Splash
effects.notes: Droplets on gravity arcs bouncing on the floor, mist, light flash.

effects.name: Whirlpool
effects.notes: Droplets riding a rising helix with streak tails; back half dimmer.

effects.name: Leaf Volley
effects.notes: Small green core shedding tumbling leaves.

effects.name: Petal Burst
effects.notes: Green flash, leaves burst out and flutter down on turbulence.

effects.name: Leaf Spiral
effects.notes: Leaves riding a rising helix.

effects.name: Spark Ball
effects.notes: Crackling core with bolts redrawn every frame and sparks.

effects.name: Thunder Strike
effects.notes: Bolt flicker drawn by the impact core plus sparks; see combo for the strike.

effects.name: Static Aura
effects.notes: Sparks crawl up the body edges.

effects.name: Ice Shards
effects.notes: Pale core shedding glinting shards and snow motes.

effects.name: Ice Beam
effects.notes: Jittering pale beam with crystals budding off the edges, shards breaking away.

effects.name: Frost Shatter
effects.notes: Shards burst out, bounce and glint; snow drifts.

effects.name: Blizzard Field
effects.notes: Diagonal snow on wind streaks over a frosted floor line.

effects.name: Force Wave
effects.notes: Tapered force crescents thinning as they travel.

effects.name: Power Hit
effects.notes: Big jagged burst, long streak sparks, dust and smoke on the floor.

effects.name: Power Aura
effects.notes: Fast rising streaks (power-up).

effects.name: Sludge Glob
effects.notes: Heavy glob shedding drips that fall away, bubbles.

effects.name: Toxic Splash
effects.notes: Goo drops bounce, bubbles rise, gas puffs.

effects.name: Poison Cloud
effects.notes: Translucent gas puffs drift and break apart; bubbles pop.

effects.name: Mud Ball
effects.notes: Tumbling clod with a dust trail.

effects.name: Quake Cracks
effects.notes: Forked cracks race out glowing then cool; chunks pop and bounce; dust.

effects.name: Dust Burst
effects.notes: Chunks bounce on the floor, dust rolls out and thins.

effects.name: Air Blade
effects.notes: Tapered crescent of wind with streaks.

effects.name: Gust Burst
effects.notes: Airy jagged burst with long wind streaks.

effects.name: Tornado
effects.notes: Wind streaks riding a rising helix, dust at the base.

effects.name: Psy Beam
effects.notes: Pink jittering beam shedding motes.

effects.name: Psy Burst
effects.notes: Jagged pink burst, swirling motes, broken shock ring on the floor.

effects.name: Mind Field
effects.notes: Motes float up and swirl around the unit.

effects.name: Buzz Wave
effects.notes: Thin tapered sound crescents with buzzing motes.

effects.name: Sting Volley
effects.notes: Sharp green core with tiny bugs shed behind.

effects.name: Sting Hit
effects.notes: Small sharp burst, bugs scatter.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.notes: Bugs ride a curl-noise flow around the centre.

effects.name: Boulder Throw
effects.notes: Faceted rock tumbling, outlined, dust trail and speed streaks.

effects.name: Rock Smash
effects.notes: Heavy chips bounce twice, dust and smoke roll.

effects.name: Stone Spikes
effects.notes: Noise-edged stone shards stab up in sequence, chips and dust, crumble back.

effects.name: Shadow Orb
effects.notes: Dark-cored orb trailing wisps that smoke out.

effects.name: Hex Burst
effects.notes: Purple burst, wisps writhe up and smoke away.

effects.name: Spirit Wisps
effects.notes: Wisps writhe up and fade to smoke.

effects.name: Dragon Beam
effects.notes: Thick blue-teal jittering beam shedding cold flames.

effects.name: Dragon Burst
effects.notes: Cold-flame burst boiling up, embers.

effects.name: Dragon Aura
effects.notes: Blue flames rise along the body.

effects.name: Night Claw
effects.notes: Three tapered rakes, hot edge cooling to plum, sparks.

effects.name: Dark Pulse
effects.notes: Dark broken rings spread from a black core with wisps (a ring by design).

effects.name: Dark Orb
effects.notes: Black-plum orb trailing writhing wisps.

effects.name: Steel Beam
effects.notes: Silver jittering beam throwing metal sparks.

effects.name: Metal Spark
effects.notes: Clang: many streak sparks arc down and bounce.

effects.name: Iron Spikes
effects.notes: Polished noise-edged spikes rise in sequence.

effects.name: Steel Slash
effects.notes: Tapered crescent sweep, hot edge, sparks off the tip.

effects.name: Moon Orb
effects.notes: Pink orb leaving twinkling stars.

effects.name: Sparkle Burst
effects.notes: Soft jagged burst, stars and hearts drift.

effects.name: Fairy Ring
effects.notes: Stars and hearts rise around the unit.

effects.name: Hit Spark
effects.notes: Smallest hit, 400 ms: jagged spark + streaks + light.

effects.name: Critical Hit
effects.notes: Two-beat crit: big jagged burst, then a second pop.

effects.name: Crit Cut-in
effects.notes: Opaque screen plate with tapered speed lines for a few frames on crits and K.O.s.

effects.name: Miss
effects.notes: After-images slide off, dust, MISS pops.

effects.name: Shield Dome
effects.notes: Broken shimmering barrier edge, hex glints, motes sliding along it.

effects.name: Heal
effects.notes: Plus glyphs and sparkles rise.

effects.name: Stat Up
effects.notes: Chevrons and streaks flow up.

effects.name: Stat Down
effects.notes: Chevrons and streaks sink.

effects.name: Burn
effects.notes: Small flames and embers on the body.

effects.name: Poison
effects.notes: Tiny bubbles rise, drips fall.

effects.name: Paralysis
effects.notes: Tiny bolts and sparks, off-beat every third frame.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.notes: Z glyphs drift up and grow.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.notes: Ice crust at the feet, falling frost motes, a glint sweeping across.

effects.name: Confusion
effects.notes: Three tiny stars circle above the head with trails.

effects.name: Faint Vanish
effects.notes: Dust puff and rising motes; play over the faint animation.

effects.name: Level Up
effects.notes: Light flash, rising streaks and stars, LV UP stamp.

effects.name: Evolve Glow
effects.notes: Silhouette beats white faster and faster in rising light, ends in a flash.

effects.name: Recall Beam
effects.notes: Jittering red beam; unit turns red, shrinks and lifts away in motes.

effects.name: Send-out Burst
effects.notes: Light flash and stars bursting as a unit appears.

effects.name: Charge Up
effects.notes: Streaks spiral into a flickering core with growing light.

effects.name: Idle Bob
effects.notes: Breathing squash/stretch, blink.

effects.name: Attack Lunge
effects.notes: Crouch wind-up held 7f, dash 2f with smear ghosts, contact freeze 4f, recover.

effects.name: Hit Recoil
effects.notes: 3 white frames, 3 frozen frames, knockback with shake, blinks, settle.

effects.name: Faint
effects.notes: Wobble, flatten, dissolve.
